The '''Uukaablis system''' was located in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], two days travel from the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. The fourth planet of the system, [[Uukaablis]], was home to the [[Uukaablian]]s.
